flash_probe.limitations: Fixed QKV attention component only, not a full LM, training, model quality or generation test. Runtime/build eligibility is separate from actual profiler evidence. Each memory baseline is reported; route order and resident/workspace allocations can differ. No speed or memory benefit is assumed.

hf.checkpoint_resume_scope: Backup includes the full experiment directory. Optimizer/RNG resume support depends on each checkpoint format and training entrypoint; a backup alone is not an exact-resume guarantee. Public inference exports remove optimizer/RNG state.
hf.verified_checkpoints_scope: The only .pt file is fixture.pt, an input fixture containing fixed Q/K/V and upstream-gradient tensors. Its hash was verified after private HF download; it contains no trained model weights or optimizer/RNG resume checkpoint and has no student-model release.
